## Testing Mode: RED

Write behavioral tests for create-story-branch.sh BEFORE implementation exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

Given epic-id + story-id as arguments:
- WHEN branch does not exist: THEN creates `story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` branch rooted at current HEAD, exits 0, prints `STORY_BRANCH=story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` to stdout
- WHEN branch already exists (idempotent): THEN exits 0, prints `STORY_BRANCH=story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` to stdout — no error
- WHEN missing epic-id or story-id args: THEN exits non-zero with usage message on stderr

## Files to create
- tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh (executable, registered in .test-index)

## Standards
Follow plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/behavioral-testing-standard.md — test observable behavior (exit codes, stdout/stderr, git state), not implementation internals. Use `git init` scratch repo in /tmp for branch assertions.
